resolves.finding: Image CLI checks primary and derived output collisions only after API execution

authorization: User explicitly chose offline mocked tests without credentials for this maintenance task.
implementation: Generate and edit preflight every primary and derived destination before creating the SDK client.
Batch generation builds and validates all output plans before creating the async client or any request tasks.

Duplicate resolved paths, conservative case-only aliases, existing hardlinks, self-aliasing downscale suffixes, and invalid output parents/targets are rejected. Force permits distinct existing regular outputs but cannot bypass duplicate-plan validation.

The write path rechecks the complete output plan after the response, decodes/downscales before writing, and exclusively reserves actual response output files before writing bytes without force. Reservation failures clean up owned empty files after identity/size checks.
Short or empty responses do not reserve unused outputs; dry-run only previews requests and paths.
Late batch output failures obey continue/fail-fast behavior and cancellation cleanup without an unhandled SystemExit.

coverage: later multi-image and batch-job collisions before any client creation
duplicate batch destinations and primary/derived overlap
case-only names and canonical/hardlink aliases even with force
read-only dry runs including existing outputs
late derived collision and reservation cleanup

verification.independent_review: Output planning, writes, batch handling, and final race/case-alias documentation reviewed; no remaining scoped finding.

limitations: Offline tests validate CLI flow and filesystem behavior; they do not validate live Image API behavior or actual Pillow transformations.
Filesystem changes after request dispatch can still incur API work. Concurrent directory/path replacement is not locked out; cleanup checks identity and size before unlinking.
Forced writes and batch jobs are not transactional across arbitrary I/O failures or jobs.
Case-only destination differences are conservatively rejected on all platforms for portable output plans.
Full verification uses existing cached PyYAML 6.0.2 for optional bundled-helper tests; no dependency was installed. Exact upstream bundle revision remains unavailable.
